sections.title: How the population has changed in Horsham
sections.label: Select another local authority

sections.content: In 2024, Horsham was the 24th largest local authority in the South East, with a population of just over 150,000. Its population increased by 1.2% compared with 2023, and has increased by 23.9% since 2001.

sections.title: Largest local authorities in the South East, 2001-2024
Population density in Horsham
sections.content: In 2024, the population density in Horsham was 286 people per square kilometre, which was less than the South East (506), and more than the United Kingdom as a whole (285).

sections.title: Densest local authorities in the South East, 2024
Median age in Horsham
sections.content: In 2024, the median age in Horsham was 45 years, which was older than the South East (41 years), and older than the United Kingdom as a whole (40 years).
